What I really want you to know

You're the best person I have ever met. Ever since you came into my life, everything has felt so much better. I genuinely feel like you're the world's best man, and there is nobody like you.

The efforts you make for me are unmatched. Sometimes I honestly wonder what I did to deserve someone like you. You do so much, even in the little things, and I notice it all.

And if sometimes my reaction seems small, or I don't express things the way you expect, please don't ever think it means I don't feel them. Sometimes I am so overwhelmed with love and emotions that I genuinely don't know how to react or put it into words. I may not always cry or show it, but that doesn't mean it doesn't mean the world to me.

I hope you always know how deeply loved, valued and appreciated you are. I am so, so lucky to have you.

Always your girl, bby ♡
